import java.util.*;

public class TheCakeIsALie_B {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
		int t = sc.nextInt();
		while(t-->0) {
			int n = sc.nextInt();
			int m = sc.nextInt();
			int k = sc.nextInt();
			
			int cost = (m-1) + (m*(n-1));
			if(cost==k) {
				System.out.println("YES");
			}
			else {
				System.out.println("NO");
			}
			
		}

	}

}
